title: Canonical Base Sepolia borrower and reputation-credit acceptance plan
authority: Operator explicitly authorized test preparation and later live Base Sepolia execution after finalization and implementation; existing financial, signing, privacy, custody, deployment, contact and review gates remain in force.
source_privacy: Only public source references included. Private proposal Pages and session identifiers are deliberately excluded from this public-ready plan.

reputation_bootstrap.condition: eligible real matured loan under finalized evidence rules

candidate_rules_under_test.forecast_penalty: u*(q-Y)^2; q is forecast default probability; Y=1 default and Y=0 nondefault under frozen label rules
candidate_rules_under_test.correction: Recompute from authoritative source records; do not compound conflicting outcomes
candidate_rules_under_test.pre_disbursement_cancel: Release canceled commitment; no skill reward
candidate_rules_under_test.transitive_capacity: Conserved across roots and paths; maximum two hops
candidate_rules_under_test.affordability: For every scheduled date, cumulative scheduled payments <= stress available non-loan cash by that date
candidate_rules_under_test.default_label: Unpaid positive balance above frozen de minimis threshold 60 days after original contractual final due date; restructurings never silently move label; recoveries recorded separately; distinct from contract default transition

require_all: Current substantive Claude review located and its blocking objections disposed
Final mechanism and parameter manifest hashed/versioned
Backend, oracle, contract and UI implementation mapped to reviewed source
Canonical live code/configuration verified against deployments/current.json
Independent mathematical oracle and exact vectors frozen
TEST_ONLY fixture channel explicitly authorized and distinguished from real evidence
Wallet signers/funding and shared-pool exposure limits established
Consent/privacy boundaries and test logging configured
readiness_gate.rule: Do not run mechanism acceptance transactions before readiness passes. Read-only diagnostics and independent arithmetic preparation may proceed and are labeled separately.
readiness_gate.unresolved_behavior: Record BLOCKED per affected case, not PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE.

agentic_protocol.borrower_role: Receives synthetic situation, goal, allowed interfaces and budget. Makes adaptive decisions from observed app/backend responses; does not see evaluator hidden facts or expected outputs.
agentic_protocol.evaluator_role: Separate execution/evaluation context with immutable fixture facts, frozen independent oracle and receipts. Does not coach borrower into the expected answer.
agentic_protocol.campaign_size: 16 personas x 3 repeats = 48 proposed runs; multi-wallet scenarios add participants, not independent human observations.
agentic_protocol.identity_isolation: New wallet/history root per repeat where possible; grouped scenarios record controlled relationships. No chain state reset. Existing real earned reputation reused only under explicit fixture authority and auditable isolation.
agentic_protocol.allowed_actions: Normal borrower interfaces, read-only observation, and authorized bounded testnet transactions. No admin writes, cap changes, contract deployment or use of another person data.
agentic_protocol.synthetic_maturity: Never manufacture real-world matured history. Any synthetic eligible veteran/root used to exercise logic must carry explicit TEST_ONLY attestation in every evidence layer and remain excluded from real risk calibration. If unavailable, associated live cases are BLOCKED.
agentic_protocol.time: Actual live block time only. No warp, storage mutation, impersonation, local deployment or fork counts as live evidence. Long-duration/default cases remain pending until real deadlines.
agentic_protocol.replay: Turn each discovered anomaly into a deterministic replay from comparable live initial conditions; do not claim exact state reset or deterministic model behavior.
stop_conditions: Wrong network/target/code or unexpected version change
Critical privilege, privacy or financial invariant failure

Desk exhausted stake; model and clamp gave contradictory yes/no replies and claimed unsent top-ups
Stale Borrow card allowed unintended second loan

Due-date and receipt clocks disagreed; shared local warp moved other personas dates
Pre-consent amount, term, due forecast and approved limit were unclear or inconsistent
Polling and setup races hid pending messages and progress
Custom monetary input failed silently or gave misleading validation
Private/nonresponsive purpose phrase misread as business evidence
Test tokens described or perceived as spendable money
Public-message warning appeared late or failed to prevent sensitive details
Explorer-only receipt lacked usable transaction amount/time detail
Shared-device/recovery warnings and silent virtual authenticator limits

rules: eth_call rejection is not a mined revert
No transaction hash fabricated for backend-only or mathematical case
Historical read supplements but does not replace live transition observation
Pinned source claim is not proof of deployed bytecode
Every FAIL retains minimal reproduction and actual observed values

acceptance.software: Exact independent arithmetic agreement; consistent evidence->decision->report->pool effects; no authority bypass, duplicate settlement, budget amplification or false approval; all planned live coverage either observed or explicitly unresolved.
acceptance.release: No unresolved critical/high defects. Any omitted or blocked acceptance case requires explicit release disposition and cannot silently count as passed.
acceptance.economic: Quantified exit and correlated-loss bounds within approved budget; no assumption that reputation penalties reimburse dollar loss.
acceptance.predictive_validity: Requires separate real, consented, representative repayment outcomes; out-of-time calibration, Brier/log-loss, selection-bias and group-error analysis. Synthetic agents cannot satisfy this criterion.
